commitResults.messageBody:
Give the chatbot its own identity instead of the template's
placeholder name: rename the class and file, and replace the
ASCII-art banner so it spells CHIONE.

Also fill in the student profile fields in AGENTS.md.

Chione now reads user commands in a loop and echoes each one back,
exiting on 'bye'. Output formatting is extracted into printBlock()
so later increments can reuse the divider-wrapped reply shape.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for storing and listing tasks
Add ability to mark tasks as done or not done
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce a Task class that owns a task's description, done state and
display format, replacing the plain strings used previously. This keeps
formatting out of Chione and gives Level-4's task subtypes a base class
to extend. Add mark and unmark commands that look a task up by its
1-based list number.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for todos, deadlines and events
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce Todo, Deadline and Event subclasses of Task, each supplying its
own type icon and extra fields via an overridden toString(). Because the
list and mark commands go through Task.toString(), they needed no change
to display the new types. Dates are kept as plain text, as the
requirements allow at this stage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid user input with a custom exception
commitResults.messageBody:
Add ChioneException so bad commands report a specific message and the
conversation continues instead of crashing.

Switch the task list from a fixed-size array to ArrayList, which removes
the capacity limit and the separate counter, and renumbers the remaining
tasks automatically after a delete.

commitResults.messageTitle: Rename remaining Duke references and declare AI usage
commitResults.messageBody:
Update the README to describe Chione instead of the Duke template, list
the supported commands, and acknowledge the use of Claude Code at AI-5 as
required by the course reuse policy.
